iter_tarfile_bytes: parse an in-memory TAR file from bytes and yield file names with memoryview contents
iter_tarfile_filelike: parse a TAR file from a file-like object and yield file names with bytes contents
iter_tarfile_memoryview: parse a TAR file from a memoryview and yield file names with memoryview slices
SupportsRead_protocol: define a Protocol requiring a read method that accepts an int and returns bytes
iter_tarfile_overload: use type overloads to distinguish between bytes and file-like object return types
